info.name: Digital Assistant Service Instance Oda API

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: List the Digital Assistant instances that belong to this compartment.

params.name: displayName
params.description:
List only the information for the Digital Assistant instance with this user-friendly name. These names don't have to be unique and may change.

Example: `My new resource`

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: List only the Digital Assistant instances that are in this lifecycle state.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page at which to start retrieving results.

You get this value from the `opc-next-page` header in a previous list request.
To retireve the first page, omit this query parameter.

Example: `MToxMA==`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort the results in this order, use either `ASC` (ascending) or `DESC` (descending).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Sort on this field. You can specify one sort order only. The default sort field is `TIMECREATED`.

The default sort order for `TIMECREATED` is descending, and the default sort order for `DISPLAYNAME` is ascending.

items.docs:
Returns a page of Digital Assistant instances that belong to the specified
compartment.

If the `opc-next-page` header appears in the response, then
there are more items to retrieve. To get the next page in the subsequent
GET request, include the header's value as the `page` query parameter.

header value and use it to call `GET /workRequests/{workRequestId}`.

info.name: Moves an Digital Assistant instance into a different compartment.

params.name: odaInstanceId
params.description: Unique Digital Assistant instance identifier.

items.docs:
Moves an Digital Assistant instance into a different compartment. When provided, If-Match is checked against
ETag values of the resource.

info.name: Starts an inactive Digital Assistant instance.

params.name: odaInstanceId
params.description: Unique Digital Assistant instance identifier.

items.docs:
Starts an inactive Digital Assistant instance. Once active, the instance will be accessible and metering
of requests will be started again.

info.name: Stops an active Digital Assistant instance.

params.name: odaInstanceId
params.description: Unique Digital Assistant instance identifier.

items.docs:
Stops an active Digital Assistant instance. Once inactive, the instance will not be accessible and metering
of requests will be stopped until the instance is started again. Data associated with the instance
is not affected.
